budget_semantics: abstract integer disclosure-risk units; not epsilon, delta, or differential-privacy accounting
required_invariants: accepted unique optional-disclosure cost never exceeds global budget in qualified profiles
identical request replay does not spend twice
reusing request identity for different content is rejected
offline escrow allocations sum to no more than the global budget
advancing policy epoch does not reset already-consumed budget within the same budget scope
optional disclosure denial never changes the separately required task decision
claim_boundary: Synthetic state-machine evaluation only; not a distributed consensus protocol, differential-privacy guarantee, credential conformance result, or production safety proof.
